description: Is a domain name free? Check one name across up to 20 TLDs at once (default com, net, org, io, ai, co, app, dev, xyz, me): available, taken (with registrar, creation and expiry dates) or likely available, from each registry's RDAP server, with DNS where a TLD has no RDAP. Use to pick a product or company name, or to check a brand before launch. Availability is not a price quote: premium and reserved names exist. Example: name=agentdatatools. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
